summary: Batch 2 end-to-end testing — 28/28 backend pytest pass + full UI verification of all 5 new pages. All 6 Batch 2 features (Import Invoice No, Multi-receiver Payment, Activity Log, RBAC Fase A, Recurring Expenses, NotificationBell) function correctly. Cross-feature integration verified: creating a recurring expense → running run-due → automatic fixed_costs entry + journal entry + NotificationBell shows 'Expense Executed Batch2 sebesar Rp 100,000 (Marketing)' + Activity Log records 'AUTO_CREATE recurring_expense'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 8089 lines (was 6577 in iter18). Strongly recommend splitting into modules (e.g., payments.py, rbac.py, recurring.py, activity.py, notifications.py) — exceeds maintainability threshold significantly.
POST /api/recurring-expenses/run-due has a dead-code branch at line 8026-8032 — second push_notification call is gated by `if False else None`, which always evaluates to None. Should be removed.

POST /api/orders/{oid}/payments wraps post_journal in `except HTTPException: pass` — silently swallows journal posting errors, meaning a payment can persist without a matching journal entry. Should at least log the failure.

DELETE /api/payment-receipts/{rid} also silently ignores journal deletion failure (delete_many will not raise, but no audit log entry is created for the deletion). Consider log_activity call for payment receipt delete.

RBAC matrix uses custom toggle buttons (no native <input type="checkbox">) — works visually but lacks data-testid like perm-{role}-{module}-{action} which would simplify automated testing. Backend toggle/save fully verified via API.

_compute_next_due for frequency='custom' falls through to default (`current_due + timedelta(days=30)`) — same as monthly default — making 'custom' equivalent to ~monthly. Either remove 'custom' from accepted frequencies or implement a custom_interval_days field.
Import Invoice Numbers endpoint has no rate limit / file size cap; large xlsx files could exhaust memory (entire content loaded with `await file.read()`). Consider streaming or size limit.
Activity Log endpoint is admin-only (correct), but `/api/notifications` is per-user — verified working via get_current_user. Good separation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 routes + all key UI flows verified)

seed_data_creation: Tests use existing AWBs (picks first non-Paid with grand_total>0) for payment receipts (creates+deletes within test, no residue). Creates+deletes 'TEST_Sewa_Batch2' recurring expense (no residue). Created one fixed_costs entry via run-due that remains (intentional, represents the auto-executed expense). RBAC update for 'finance' role on first module (orders_input) sets view=true, create/edit/delete/import/export=false — this state persists in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 2 features all stable. Key verifications: (1) GET /api/orders/{oid}/payments returns {grand_total,total_paid,remaining,is_fully_paid,receipts[]}. (2) POST /api/orders/{oid}/payments triggers AWB.status='Paid' when total_paid>=grand_total; DELETE reverts to 'Invoiced'. (3) POST /api/rbac/update with role='administrator' returns 400. (4) POST /api/recurring-expenses/run-due creates fixed_costs entries + push_notifications + activity_logs + increments occurrence_count + advances next_due. (5) NotificationBell badge updates in real-time after run-due. (6) Frontend login: data-testid=login-username-input, login-password-input; uses 'Masuk' button (no submit type — use button:has-text('Masuk')). Login flow needs press_sequentially or click+type, plain page.fill() may timeout. (7) RBAC matrix toggles are custom buttons not native checkboxes — selector via [data-testid^='perm-'] does not exist; would need addition by main agent for fine-grained UI test. (8) Modal-close: Escape key did NOT close Import Invoice No modal — couldn't test Payments modal in same script run (overlay intercepted). Click outside or explicit close button preferred.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues. Two minor code-quality observations: dead code in run-due notifications (line 8026-8032), and silent except HTTPException pass on journal entries in payments. Neither blocks Batch 2 functionality.
